## Observation
Split from d23c (which skips one test). On the Windows sweep (run 35551741150, job 106187634058, 2026-09-21) the runner has no OpenSSH that `rebar.attest.sshsig.ssh_keygen_version()` can find, and op-cert signing needs 8.9 or newer. Reproduced on this macOS host (real ssh is OpenSSH 10.3, where all 97 tests below pass) with a PATH shim whose `ssh -V` prints `OpenSSH_8.8p1`: 50 of 97 tests in 5 modules fail, 47 pass. 46 of the 50 also fail in the Windows log with an OpenSSH-related message; 2 fail there for a different reason; 2 do not fail there (one skips first on a platform check).

## Measured per module (shim run 2026-10-25)
| module | tests | fail | pass |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| tests/unit/test_opcert_local_verify_binding.py | 12 | 11 | 1 |
| tests/unit/test_attestation_invalidation.py | 39 | 15 | 24 |
| tests/unit/test_opcert_binding_thread_propagation_ff4a.py | 8 | 5 | 3 |
| tests/unit/test_opcert_producer_seam_8d8e.py | 24 | 17 | 7 |
| tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py | 14 | 2 | 12 |

The same condition surfaces as 4 shapes: SshKeygenUnavailable (27), SigningError telling the user to install OpenSSH (18), OpcertKeyUnavailable (2), and plain assertion failures (3). A module-level `_SSH_OK` skip, the idiom three other opcert modules use, would skip 35 passing tests in the four modules here.

## Open question (user decision pending)
Skip per test, or provision OpenSSH 8.9 or newer on the Windows sweep runner so the tests run. Not decided here.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every test that fails under the OpenSSH 8.8 shim is classified as needing a real signer or as testing the no-ssh path, with the classification recorded (checked: a table in a ticket comment covering all 50).
- [ ] After the chosen fix, the same shim run reports 0 failed in these 5 modules, and the run with the real ssh still reports every test that passed before still passing (checked: both `pytest` summaries recorded in a ticket comment).
- [ ] `make verify` shows no failure outside the known pandoc set, and the Gerrit change is `Verified +1`.
